title: 第21章 挂3 疯批二师妹第22章 十年后你敢与我一战吗
slug: 全宗开挂大师姐她就爱贴脸开大
lines: “谁在欺负我天衍宗弟子！”
一道声波就让全场人感觉心都被震了一下，殷裴四周环顾不知谁在说话，魏明等人却是一愣，这声音，有点耳熟啊。
“二师姐…”
“是二师姐的声音！”
几人瞬间激动的不知如何是好，都想化身猿人捶胸大吼来表达他们内心的兴奋了。
是二师姐历练回来了！
二师姐可也是元婴修士！
他们有救了！
他们有救了！
和魏明几人的激动不同，殷裴和沈知意脸色就不怎么好看了。
二师姐？
林筱也是心一动，原着中她最喜欢角色的就是天衍宗的二师姐蒋凤熙了。
用一个词来形容蒋凤熙，疯批二字再合适不过。
性子阴晴不定，做事全凭心情，一言不合就动手，遇事不爽就开干，这都是蒋凤熙的形容词，外宗弟子甚至背地里都称蒋凤熙为蒋疯子。
可在天衍宗弟子眼里，蒋凤熙却是他们有力的保护伞。
若在天衍宗内发起一个投票，问亲传弟子中谁最护短，想必八成的弟子都会投蒋凤熙一票。
这样的强烈反差，当真是爱她的人爱死，恨她的人恨得牙痒痒。
林筱自然是前者。
唯一不好的就是，蒋凤熙喜欢洛云卿。
这在林筱看来，和一朵鲜花插在牛粪上没区别。
蒋凤熙是第一个被洛云卿收入后宫的女子，也是因为她，洛云卿才打开了百合世界的门，觉得女子竟也可以如此飒气，不输半分男子的气势。
宗门大比不仅让洛云卿打开了岳子舒的心房，也成功吸引了蒋凤熙的注意。
洛云卿外表柔柔弱弱，动起手来却如小草一般的坚韧，这样的反差让蒋凤熙为她侧目。
相处的久了，蒋凤熙没按耐住内心的冲动，和洛云卿表白。
洛云卿当时很惊讶，她对蒋凤熙说实话并没有那种男女之情，可是蒋凤熙的天赋和实力对她而言却是一大助力，若是得到了，她修炼起来也会容易许多。
这么想着，洛云卿答应了。
本来是违心同意，可慢慢的，洛云卿被蒋凤熙身上那种寻常女子所没有的英气打动，也动了心。
‘踏踏’的脚步声从半空传来，林筱抬头差点被晃到眼睛，红袍猎猎，发丝如瀑，阳光打在女子身上就像成为了她的背景，她身上的光比太阳还耀眼而热烈。
每走一步，虚空就像是无法承受她身上强大的气息般发出震颤。
红衣女子环着胸，狭长的凤眸锁定下方的沈知意，居高临下懒散着轻嘲开口。
“我看到了什么？沈知意，你一个元婴修士居然欺负我天衍宗几个金丹弟子，我看你是越活越回去了。”
沈知意身形一闪，再一次出现来到了蒋凤熙对面。
他声音淡漠：“是你的弟子先欺负我师弟的。”
“不是，二师姐，是，是殷裴他……”
魏明几番犹豫还是没说出殷裴勾结洛云卿的事，只是道，“我和几位弟子出来做任务，是殷裴半路冒出二话不说对我等下杀手，如果不是大师姐及时相救，我们说不定已经惨遭殷裴毒手。”
魏明说完偷偷瞟了林筱一眼，现在他每次维护洛云卿都莫名心虚，觉得对不起大师姐。
他告诉他自己，说不定是大师姐搞错了，云卿师妹不是那样的人。
等回去宗门，一切误会解开，大师姐会和云卿师妹和解的。
“大师姐？”
听到魏明的话，蒋凤熙眉头一掀，她刚只看到了魏明身上带着的弟子徽章，倒没注意魏明几人都是谁。
此刻一瞧，那个灰头土脸的，好像还真是她那个性格胆小的大师姐。
本来没想下去，看见林筱在，蒋凤熙稍一思索，便回到了地面。
“师姐。”
content_en:
"Who is bullying my disciple of Tianyan Sect!"
A sound wave made everyone in the audience feel their hearts shaken. Yin Pei looked around and didn't know who was speaking, but Wei Ming and others were stunned. This voice sounded a bit familiar.
"Second Senior Sister..."
"It's Second Senior Sister's voice!"
Several people were so excited that they didn't know what to do. They all wanted to turn into apes and beat their chests and roar to express their inner excitement.
It's Second Senior Sister who has returned from training!
The second senior sister is also a Nascent Soul cultivator!
They are saved!
They are saved!
Different from the excitement of Wei Ming and others, Yin Pei and Shen Zhiyi's expressions were not so good.
Second senior sister?
Lin Xiao was also moved. Her favorite character in the original work was Jiang Fengxi, the second senior sister of Tianyan Sect.
To describe Jiang Fengxi in one word, the word "crazy criticism" is most suitable.
He has a volatile temperament, does things based on his mood, takes action when he disagrees, and takes action when he is upset. These are all adjectives for Jiang Fengxi. The disciples of the outer sect even call Jiang Fengxi Crazy Jiang behind his back.
But in the eyes of Tianyan Sect disciples, Jiang Fengxi is their powerful protective umbrella.
If a poll were held within the Tianyan Sect and asked who among the direct disciples was the most protective of his shortcomings, 80% of the disciples would definitely vote for Jiang Fengxi.
Such a strong contrast really makes those who love her love her to death, and those who hate her hate her to death.
Lin Xiao is naturally the former.
The only bad thing is that Jiang Fengxi likes Luo Yunqing.
In Lin Xiao's opinion, this is no different from a flower stuck in cow dung.
Jiang Fengxi was the first woman to be admitted into the harem by Luo Yunqing. It was because of her that Luo Yunqing opened the door to Lily World and felt that women could be so sassy and not lose half of the momentum of men.
The sect competition not only opened Luo Yunqing's heart to Yue Zishu, but also successfully attracted Jiang Fengxi's attention.
Luo Yunqing looked soft and frail, but when she moved her hands she was as tough as grass. This contrast made Jiang Fengxi look at her sideways.
After getting along for a long time, Jiang Fengxi couldn't hold back her inner impulse and confessed her feelings to Luo Yunqing.
Luo Yunqing was surprised at the time. She told Jiang Fengxi that she didn't have that kind of love between men and women, but Jiang Fengxi's talent and strength were a great help to her. If she got it, it would be much easier for her to practice.
With this in mind, Luo Yunqing agreed.
Initially he agreed against his will, but gradually, Luo Yunqing was moved by the heroic spirit in Jiang Fengxi that ordinary women did not have, and he also fell in love.
…
The sound of "tapping" footsteps came from mid-air. Lin Xiao raised his head and was almost shaken in the eyes. He was wearing a red robe and hair like a waterfall. The sunlight hitting the woman seemed to be her background. The light on her body was more dazzling and warm than the sun.
With every step she took, the void trembled as if it couldn't bear the powerful aura on her body.
The woman in red crossed her chest, her narrow phoenix eyes locked on Shen Zhiyi below, and spoke lazily and mockingly from above.
"What did I see? Shen Zhiyi, you, a Nascent Soul cultivator, actually bullied several of my Tianyan Sect's Golden Elixir disciples. I think you are getting better and better."
Shen Zhiyi flashed and appeared opposite Jiang Fengxi again.
His voice was indifferent: "It was your disciple who bullied my junior brother first."
"No, Second Senior Sister, yes, it's Yin Pei..."
Wei Ming hesitated several times but still did not say anything about Yin Pei's collusion with Luo Yunqing. He just said, "I and several disciples went out to do a mission, but Yin Pei came out in the middle without saying a word and waited for me to kill me. If the senior sister hadn't rescued us in time, we might have been killed by Yin Pei."
After Wei Ming finished speaking, he glanced at Lin Xiao secretly. Now he felt inexplicably guilty every time he defended Luo Yunqing and felt sorry for his senior sister.
He told himself that maybe the senior sister had made a mistake, and junior sister Yunqing was not that kind of person.
After returning to the sect, all misunderstandings will be resolved, and Senior Sister will reconcile with Junior Sister Yunqing.
"Sister?"
Hearing Wei Ming's words, Jiang Fengxi raised her eyebrows. She just saw the disciple badge that Wei Ming was wearing, but she didn't pay attention to who Wei Ming was.
At this moment, at a glance, the gray-faced one seemed to be her timid elder sister.
She didn't think about it at first, but when she saw Lin Xiao, Jiang Fengxi thought for a moment and returned to the ground.
"Sister."
